metadata.name: Startup Idea Validation
metadata.description: Evidence-led startup idea validation from free-form input to a durable local decision package: frames the decision, researches traceable current evidence, analyzes market, demand, competitors, alternatives, technical feasibility, economics, team, regulation and risks, proposes uncertainty-reduction experiments, creates a self-contained offline HTML report, runs deterministic package checks and genuinely independent semantic review, and routes cause-owned repair or contract reassessment. Autonomous mode skips human waits only; interactive mode supports clarification and accepted-result rework. Publication and Telegram notification are separately authorized optional effects whose failure never invalidates the local package. Outcomes distinguish complete local validation, blocked prerequisites and explicit abort.

nodes.directive: Reuse the originating free-form startup idea between these markers: ---BEGIN IDEA--- {{startup_idea}} ---END IDEA---. Reuse the originating decision scope, constraints and authority. Resolve operating_mode plus publication_authority and notification_authority without re-asking explicit decisions. Classify the idea as actionable, clarify, or blocked. Missing material facts that cannot be discovered are clarify only in interactive mode; autonomous ambiguity that prevents responsible analysis is blocked. Do not fabricate product fields, evidence, permission or professional clearance.
nodes.completionCondition: The bounded input, mode and separate side-effect authority are truthfully resolved

nodes.directive: Work only in the current execution workspace {{workspace_path}}. Present only the decision-critical ambiguity and its consequence. Ask the user to provide bounded clarification or abort; write the exact decision and feedback to repair-account.md. Do not research, analyze, or expand authority.
nodes.completionCondition: The user supplies actionable clarification or explicitly aborts

nodes.directive: Work only in the current execution workspace {{workspace_path}}. Read the original idea and exact clarification in repair-account.md. Apply only its real reach to the durable input understanding, preserving every unaffected constraint and authority. Proceed to canonical framing; do not begin research or rematerialize the workspace.
nodes.completionCondition: The clarification is durably incorporated without scope or authority drift

nodes.directive: Work only in the current execution workspace {{workspace_path}}. Verify workspace correlation. Read the original idea and constraints, then write idea-framing.md with target user, problem, proposed value, relevant geography/regulation, business-model hypotheses, requested decision, assumptions, material unknowns and evidence needs. Return ready only when responsible research can begin; replan for an invalid interpretation/criterion and blocked for an irreducible prerequisite.
nodes.completionCondition: The canonical framing is complete or its earliest non-product cause is truthfully classified

nodes.directive: Work only in the current execution workspace {{workspace_path}}. Read idea-framing.md and conduct source-led research proportionate to the idea. Write source-register.md and evidence-research.md covering problem/demand, market, alternatives/competitors and material regulatory evidence. Link and date current claims, expose contradictions and missing evidence, and never invent fixed counts, market values or clearance. Return limited only when a useful bounded decision remains possible with explicit limitations; replan for an invalid evidence method; blocked for an irreducible prerequisite.
nodes.completionCondition: The research corpus is traceable and ready or limited truthfully, or its earliest failure is classified

nodes.directive: Work only in the current execution workspace {{workspace_path}}. Read framing, source register and evidence research. Write feasibility-options.md integrating technical feasibility, delivery and operating economics, capabilities/team, material risks, business-model alternatives or pivots and concrete uncertainty-reduction experiments. Estimates disclose inputs, method, range, date/currency/geography and uncertainty. Treat high-stakes questions as risk discovery requiring qualified review.
nodes.completionCondition: A complete cross-domain feasibility and options analysis is durable without fabricated precision

nodes.directive: Work only in the current execution workspace {{workspace_path}}. Read all canonical primary artifacts. Write decision.md and a self-contained report.html with embedded assets only. The decision may proceed, proceed conditionally, experiment, reframe, pause or stop and must follow evidence. The HTML visibly separates facts, sources, calculations, estimates, hypotheses, assumptions, uncertainty, contradictions, limitations, risks, blockers and next experiments. Do not write terminal summaries; package completion derives them from the exact completed bytes.
nodes.completionCondition: The canonical decision and offline report coherently express the evidence-led result

nodes.directive: Work only in the current execution workspace {{workspace_path}}. Perform a fresh producer completion pass over the original idea, framing, source register, evidence, feasibility/options, decision and actual HTML. Close obvious omitted domains, broken claim links, stale conclusions and presentation omissions before gates. For ready, derive and return recommendation_summary and limitations_summary from the exact current decision/package bytes, replacing any stale earlier summaries. Return replan for an invalid contract/evidence method, or blocked for an irreducible prerequisite.
nodes.completionCondition: The complete local package and its current bounded summaries are producer-ready, or the earliest non-product cause is classified

nodes.directive: Work only in the current execution workspace {{workspace_path}}. Read the actual canonical files and run only applicable cheap deterministic checks. Record exact observations in package-validation.md. Check required files/structure, source-register shape, parsable HTML and absence of network/CDN/fetch/form runtime dependencies. Mechanical green proves only measured properties. Return package_repair for a concrete package defect, replan for an invalid or non-discriminating criterion, and blocked for an irreducible validation prerequisite. Do not build a validator to prove another validator ran.
nodes.completionCondition: Deterministic package properties pass or their earliest cause is classified without surrogate semantic proof

nodes.directive: Work only in the current execution workspace {{workspace_path}}. Read the current validation or semantic report, repair-account.md and actual package. Reproduce every package-owned blocker and change all real manifestations inside scope, including presentation-only defects. Record root class and changed relevant knowledge in repair-account.md. Return changed only after mutation; reassess for invalid/mixed/unreproduced/same-root-without-new-knowledge causes; blocked for an irreducible local repair.
nodes.completionCondition: Confirmed package defects change coherently or non-local causes do not loop

nodes.directive: Work only in the current execution workspace {{workspace_path}}. Delegate one genuinely independent whole-package review and keep the same reviewer context for rereview where supported. The reviewer reads the original idea/authority, every canonical artifact, direct sources, validation observations and HTML, then overwrites semantic-review.md with all current reproducible blockers. It diagnoses without repair, accepts zero findings, and classifies package, evidence, invalid criterion or upstream causes. Return pass only at zero blockers; repair only for one local owner; replan for mixed/upstream/criterion or repeated unchanged roots; blocked when genuine independence or another prerequisite is unavailable without claiming review.
nodes.completionCondition: A complete independent semantic review or factual inability record is durable and cause-correct

nodes.directive: Work only in the current execution workspace {{workspace_path}}. Read semantic-review.md, source-register.md, evidence-research.md and primary sources. Reproduce every evidence-owned blocker, change the complete confirmed evidence class, and record changed relevant knowledge in repair-account.md. Return changed to recompute every evidence-dependent artifact; reassess for invalid/mixed/unreproduced/repeated roots; blocked for an irreducible evidence prerequisite.
nodes.completionCondition: Evidence defects change before all dependent conclusions are recomputed, or non-local causes do not loop

nodes.directive: Work only in the current execution workspace {{workspace_path}}. Read the original idea and authority, framing, decision, exact current validation/review/contract report, repair-account.md and primary evidence. Correct only the earliest invalid interpretation, criterion, evidence method, scope or authority while preserving the goal. Record changed relevant knowledge. Return eligible only with a materially corrected contract; blocked for an irreducible prerequisite; aborted only for an explicit authorized user stop.
nodes.completionCondition: The earliest invalid derived contract is corrected for independent review or ends truthfully

nodes.directive: Work only in the current execution workspace {{workspace_path}}. Delegate a genuinely independent review of the corrected task/criterion/evidence/authority contract and keep the same reviewer context for rereview where supported. The reviewer reads original authority, repair-account.md, framing, exact cause report and primary evidence, overwrites contract-review.md, diagnoses without mutation and returns pass, repair, replan or blocked. Pass alone may resume producers; repair/replan return to reassessment; blocked records unavailable independence without claiming review.
nodes.completionCondition: The corrected contract is independently accepted or its cause/inability is durable

nodes.directive: Work only in the current execution workspace {{workspace_path}}. Present the independently accepted local decision package without treating preference as semantic proof. Ask the user to accept, request bounded rework with actionable feedback, or abort. Acceptance does not expand publication or notification authority.
nodes.completionCondition: The user accepts, provides actionable rework feedback, or aborts

nodes.directive: Work only in the current execution workspace {{workspace_path}}. Record the exact feedback and classified earliest owner in repair-account.md before routing. Read exact user feedback and actual accepted artifacts. Reproduce its real reach and return framing, evidence, analysis, presentation, reassess or blocked. Do not mutate here or use user preference to waive semantic requirements.
nodes.completionCondition: Rework is classified to the earliest stale owner without mutation or authority drift

nodes.directive: Work only in the current execution workspace {{workspace_path}}. Ask once whether to publish the already accepted self-contained HTML. Explain that local completion is already valid and publication is an optional external mutation. Return publish or local without changing the package.
nodes.completionCondition: Publication is explicitly authorized or declined

nodes.directive: Work only in the current execution workspace {{workspace_path}}. Read the accepted local report.html and use the Moira artifact API only under resolved publication authority. Return succeeded with the actual public URL, or failed with a factual reason. Do not change the package or retry research.
nodes.completionCondition: The optional upload is observed truthfully while the local package remains intact

nodes.directive: Work only in the current execution workspace {{workspace_path}}. Ask once whether to send a completion notification for the already accepted local package. Explain that a public link is included only if publication succeeded. Return send or skip.
nodes.completionCondition: Notification is explicitly authorized or declined

nodes.directive: Work only in the current execution workspace {{workspace_path}}. Send one authorized completion notification. Include public_url only when publication_status is succeeded; otherwise report validation completion without implying access to a local path. Return sent or failed from the actual tool observation. Do not alter the accepted package.
nodes.completionCondition: The optional notification outcome is observed without relabelling validation

nodes.directive: Work only in the current execution workspace {{workspace_path}}. Resolved publication authority is {{publication_authority}} and notification authority is {{notification_authority}}; use actual optional-effect observations when present. Write final-report.md from the independently accepted local package and actual optional-effect observations. Project the already accepted recommendation_summary and limitations_summary verbatim without semantic reinterpretation or rewriting. Report local availability, exact declined/not_requested/attempted publication and notification status, and side-effect failure truthfully. Return complete with artifact_path exactly {{workspace_path}}/final-report.md and a bounded summary. Do not publish, notify, commit, push or mutate the package here.
nodes.completionCondition: The accepted local validation and optional effects are truthfully projected

nodes.directive: Work only in the current execution workspace {{workspace_path}}. Write final-report.md with the factual blocker, completed safe work, preserved artifacts and the exact evidence/authority/prerequisite needed to resume. Do not claim independent acceptance or optional-effect success. Return blocked with current final-report path and bounded summary.
nodes.completionCondition: The blocker and preserved local state are durable and truthfully projected

nodes.directive: Report materialization failure factually without claiming a workspace artifact exists. Preserve the original idea and name the concrete prerequisite required to retry. Return blocked and a bounded summary.
nodes.completionCondition: Workspace failure is truthful and no nonexistent artifact is projected

nodes.directive: Work only in the current execution workspace {{workspace_path}}. Honor the explicit interactive abort without further analysis or external effects. Write final-report.md with where the run stopped and preserved local artifacts. Return aborted with the current final-report path and bounded summary.
nodes.completionCondition: The authorized abort is durable and distinct from failure or completion

nodes.hint: Use only when the accepted startup-validation task, criterion, evidence method, authority or process itself no longer matches reality. Do not use it for ordinary research gaps, package defects, failed checks, semantic findings or optional side-effect failures; those have normal owners.
nodes.directive: Use only when the in-run contract no longer matches reality. Record the concrete process-revision cause, earliest invalid derived source, preserved goal/authority and changed relevant knowledge in repair-account.md. Do not use this jump for ordinary research, validation, review or side-effect failures that already have owners.
nodes.completionCondition: A legitimate changed process cause and its invalidation reach are durable for normal contract reassessment

startup_idea.description: Free-form startup idea from the originating request.

operating_mode.description: Whether human clarification and acceptance waits are enabled.

publication_authority.description: Originating authority for optional public artifact upload.

notification_authority.description: Originating authority for optional Telegram notification.

workspace_path.description: Execution-correlated workspace for the canonical startup validation package.

recommendation_summary.description: Bounded recommendation summary from the canonical decision.

public_url.description: Public artifact URL after successful authorized publication.

artifact_path.description: Validated final report path in the current workspace.
